title: Rammed Earth Layer Compaction Visualizer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that visualizes the process of building a rammed earth wall through sequential layer compaction. The scene simulates how rammed earth construction works: loose soil is poured into a formwork, then compacted with a rammer tool, reducing its height and increasing its density.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a perspective camera at position (4, 5, 6) looking at the origin.
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Ground plane: 10x10 flat plane with a sandy/dirt color (#8B7355), receiving shadows.
- Formwork: Two transparent (opacity 0.3) vertical panels on left and right sides of the wall area, each 2.0 wide (X), 4.0 tall (Y), 0.1 thick (Z), spaced 0.8 apart in Z. Use a wooden brown color (#A0522D). These represent the formwork mold.
- The wall builds upward inside the formwork. Each layer starts as a loose soil box (2.0 x LOOSE_HEIGHT x 0.8) where LOOSE_HEIGHT = 0.5.
- A rammer tool: a vertical cylinder (radius 0.15, height 1.2) positioned above the current layer, colored dark gray (#444444).

PHYSICS / COMPACTION MODEL:
- Compaction ratio: 0.6 (compacted height = loose height * 0.6, so 0.5 * 0.6 = 0.3 per layer).
- Each layer has a moisture content randomly assigned between 8% and 16% (stored as a float).
- Optimal moisture is 12%. Compaction efficiency = 1.0 - abs(moisture - 12) / 12. This affects final density.
- Base density of loose earth: 1600 kg/m³. Compacted density = 1600 / compaction_ratio * compaction_efficiency.
- Maximum 8 layers can be stacked. Total wall height = sum of all compacted layer heights.
- Each compaction takes 3 rammer strikes. The rammer animates downward on each strike.

LAYER COLORS:
- Each layer gets a slightly different earth tone. Use HSL with hue between 20-35, saturation 40-60%, lightness varying by moisture (drier = lighter, wetter = darker). Range lightness from 35% (wet) to 55% (dry).

USER INTERACTIONS:
1. POUR button (DOM button, id='btn-pour'): Adds a new loose soil layer on top of the wall at the correct Y position. The layer appears with LOOSE_HEIGHT and is uncompacted. Disabled if current layer is not yet compacted or max layers reached.
2. COMPACT button (DOM button, id='btn-compact'): Performs one rammer strike on the current top layer. Each strike reduces the layer height by 1/3 of the total compaction delta. After 3 strikes, the layer is fully compacted. The rammer visually moves down and back up. Disabled if no uncompacted layer exists.
3. REMOVE FORMWORK button (DOM button, id='btn-remove-formwork'): Only enabled when at least 4 layers are fully compacted. Animates the formwork panels sliding outward in Z over 1 second, revealing the finished wall.
4. Keyboard 'R' key: Resets the entire scene to initial state (0 layers, formwork back in place).
5. Click on any compacted layer in the 3D scene to select it and display its properties in the HUD.

HUD (top-right corner, id='hud-panel'):
- Display: current layer count (span id='hud-layer-count'), total wall height in meters (span id='hud-wall-height'), selected layer info including layer number, moisture %, density, and compacted height (div id='hud-selected-info').
- Also show average wall density (span id='hud-avg-density').

STATE MANAGEMENT - Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- layerCount: number of layers added (0-8)
- layers: array of objects {index, looseHeight, compactedHeight, moisture, density, strikes, isCompacted, yPosition}
- currentStrikes: strikes applied to current top layer (0-3)
- totalWallHeight: sum of compacted heights of all fully compacted layers (float)
- formworkRemoved: boolean
- selectedLayerIndex: number or null (-1 if none)
- averageDensity: average density across all compacted layers (float, 0 if none)
- rammerY: current Y position of the rammer tool
- compactionRatio: 0.6 (constant)
- maxLayers: 8
- isAnimating: boolean, true during rammer or formwork animation

ENSURE:
- All numerical state values are never NaN.
- Layer Y positions are consistent: each layer sits on top of the previous compacted layer.
- Total wall height equals the sum of individual compacted heights.
- Density calculations follow the formula exactly.
- The rammer repositions above the current top layer after each pour.
- Buttons enable/disable states are correct at all times.
physics_constraints: Compaction ratio is 0.6 (compacted = loose * 0.6). Compacted density = (1600 / 0.6) * efficiency where efficiency = 1.0 - |moisture - 12| / 12. Moisture per layer is random in [8, 16]. Total wall height must equal sum of all compacted layer heights. Layer Y positions stack sequentially. Maximum 8 layers. Each compaction requires exactly 3 strikes.
